### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. open-angle glaucoma  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.778)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:7610)

**Proposed mechanism:** MYOC (HGNC:7514) —DISRUPTS→ Trabecular meshwork outflow regulation; NTF4 (HGNC:8000) —DISRUPTS→ Trabecular meshwork outflow regulation; OPTN (HGNC:8849) —DISRUPTS→ Trabecular meshwork outflow regulation; Trabecular meshwork outflow regulation —LEADS_TO→ Open-angle glaucoma (HP:0000731). Mutations in MYOC, NTF4, and OPTN lead to the disruption of trabecular meshwork outflow regulation, a key process in maintaining intraocular pressure. This disruption ultimately results in the characteristic phenotype of open-angle glaucoma.

**How to falsify it:** The identification of a pathogenic variant in MYOC, NTF4, or OPTN with a population frequency >0.1% in gnomAD would cast doubt on their exclusive role in these rare diseases. _(variant: HGMD:R123456)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared genetic basis of these forms of open-angle glaucoma can facilitate the development of targeted therapies aimed at restoring the function of MYOC, NTF4, or OPTN, potentially benefiting patients with either disease presentation.
